mods.name: ApocaHUD43
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Keeps the HUD on the screen edges at any aspect ratio (4:3, 16:10, 21:9).

latest.title: ApocaHUD43 1.0.2
latest.notes:
Keeps Apocalypter's HUD on the screen edges at any aspect ratio (4:3, 16:10, 21:9).

The game lays its HUD out for 16:9 with everything anchored to the screen centre, so on 4:3 the bottom row (weapon card, survival card, quick items, ammo / nuts / armour, compass) hangs above the bottom of the screen. ApocaHUD43 re-anchors each element to the edge or corner it was designed next to:

- bottom / top rows stick to the bottom / top edge, corner groups to their corners
- survival rows (health, hunger, thirst, fatigue, sanity, radiation) stay in the bottom-left corner
- the loading screen picture covers the whole screen (aspect kept, edges cropped)
- the middle of the screen (crosshair, item names, prompts, scopes) is unchanged; at 16:9 nothing moves
- works with Apocapocket's extra slot card 4 / 5 / 6

**Install:** BepInEx 5.4.x; copy `ApocaHUD43.dll` from the zip into `Apocalypter\BepInEx\plugins\`.
Config: `[General] Enabled` (live toggle, also in the Apocasetter Mods menu).

mods.name: Apocapatrol
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Raider gangs in scrap-built cars, trucks and bikes roam the wasteland, hunt you down and carry loot worth taking.

latest.title: Apocapatrol 1.20.3
latest.notes:
## Changes since 1.9.1

**Bikers**
- New Halfbreed motorcycles in basic and advanced versions.
- New spawn groups: Basic, Advanced and Super Bikers.
- 30% of convoys now get motorcycle escorts.

**Cars**
- New Poloska, TinyTyrant and Junker looks (TinyTyrant has its own raider texture); Halfbreed paint.
- Every raider car now has headlights, and they are switched on.
- Doors open before NPCs get out, or before a passenger kicks out a dead driver.
- Doors, hood and trunk now sit where the game places them.
- Junkers: no windshield on the advanced one, and the metal plates are removed.

**Loot**
- Cars (except trucks and motorcycles) may carry an ammo box (70%) or a bandage (30%) on the back seat.
- The roll scales with LootMultiplier, and advanced cars get double.
- Cargo boxes only spawn in trucks.

**Fixes**
- Paint jobs survive save/load, including Steam Cloud saves (raider data is now stored inside the save file).
- Engines popped off exploded cars lie still and can be picked up.
- Wrecks get high grip only while they settle after the explosion, then return to normal physics.
- Melee weapons (knives etc.) now damage wheels fitted on cars. With Apocaraider 1.5.4+, Apocaraider's own rules apply.

**Config and tools**
- MinConvoyCooldown and MaxConvoyCooldown are back in [Scaling].
- New [Debug] CustomPaintjobs switch (on by default).
- F3 spawner menu: simulated km travelled and boss kills; "Spawn (game roll)" picks exactly like the game.
- Car templates (made with Apocatemplater) can list several kinds, e.g. `small;motorcycle`.

mods.name: Apocapocket
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Weapon slots 1-3 also hold ordinary items, and a backpack adds item slots 4-6.

latest.title: Apocapocket 2.0.0
latest.notes:
# Apocapocket 2.0.0

Six logical slots now hold items and weapons, with explicit inventory transactions and rollback when a game operation times out.

- Store and retrieve ordinary items with their recorded hand pose. Switching slots and Weapon off return held items to their origin, a free slot, or the world when all slots are occupied.
- Pick up weapons with Use / F into the first free slot in order 1–6, including automatic drawing when that slot is already selected.
- Unlock slots 4, 4–5 or 4–6 with the worn backpack. Removing or downsizing it ejects overflow after a short stable gameplay delay.
- Expand the original slot card progressively to 1–4, 1–5 and 1–6 while preserving texture scale and end caps. The ammo/value panel and card's right edge stay fixed; the slot row and grenade/drop/unequip hints move left as capacity increases.
- Save logical slot mappings and hand poses inside the game's ES3 save. Ordinary stored items and extra-slot weapons are normalized to physical world items during serialization, then restored to the inventory.
- Cache generated item icons on disk; retain native item icons when available.
- Fix the Unity `Start() can not take parameters` error by renaming the transaction entry method. Verification now checks Unity lifecycle signatures on all plugin MonoBehaviours.

## Installation

Requires Apocalypter and BepInEx 5.4.x. Copy `Apocapocket.dll` into `BepInEx/plugins/Apocapocket`, replacing the previous version. Keep only one copy of the plugin DLL and restart the game. Existing extra-slot key bindings and the plugin GUID are retained.

## Validation and known limits

The production inventory, transaction and persistence code passed 77 checks with headless adapters. The plugin compiled against the installed game assemblies; all four Harmony patches and Unity lifecycle signatures passed the assembly smoke checks.

The expanding artwork was confirmed in-game. The latest leftward layout correction and the complete save/load, vehicle and physical-item acceptance scenarios still need in-game verification; see `VALIDATION.md` in the source and release archive. The native Unity mesh check could not run because the local editor lacked an activated license.

Stale inventory mappings from saves written without the plugin are detected using the saved vanilla Timeline. A re-save with an exactly unchanged Timeline cannot be distinguished by this check. Hand-carried items remain under vanilla/Apocasaver save handling.

mods.name: Apocaraider
mods.author: DeonUrist

mods.deprecatedReason: Apocaraider has been split into four mods you can pick separately. Install the ones you want and disable Apocaraider: running it together with them applies the same features twice.

latest.title: Apocaraider 1.7.0
latest.notes:
## Changes since 1.5.5

- **Shoota - female Sprokka:** a share of the Sprokkas the game spawns are now Shootas, with their own body, no armour vest, the female voice, and their own corpse. They stay Shootas after save and load.
- **New setting `FemalePopulation` (50 %):** how many Flexas and Sprokkas spawn as Gungirls / Shootas, right under EnableFemaleNpc.
- **Smoother walk to a checked spot:** raiders heading to a gunshot or a sighting leave their camp or cave through the best exit and walk there as smoothly as they walk back home.
- **Melee on corpses:** knife, shiv and machete hits on a body bleed instead of raising dust, and blades make a stabbing sound.

Install: copy the `Apocaraider` folder from the zip into `BepInEx\plugins\` (replace the old one). New files: `Models\Sprokka_female.glb`, `Models\sprokka_female.png`, `Sounds\knifestab.wav`.

mods.name: Apocasaver
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Autosave into the slot you are playing and give your saves names.

latest.title: Apocasaver 1.7.1
latest.notes:
## 1.7.1

- **Fix: save names forgotten on some PCs.** On Windows set to a date format with dots or dashes (for example `30.09.2026`, common in many regions even with English as the language), the mod could not read back the name in a slot's label. The naming popup came up empty and autosaves dropped the name. Slot labels are now always stamped as `dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm`, and labels stamped by 1.7.0 with dots or dashes are recognised too, so existing names come back.

Install: replace `BepInEx\plugins\Apocasaver.dll`. Requires BepInEx 5.x.

mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Spawn any item, vehicle or trailer from a searchable window (F4).

latest.title: Apocaspawner 1.3.1
latest.notes:
## Apocaspawner 1.3.1

**Tidy, sorted `[Names]` section.**

- On every game start the names already in the config are loaded in alphabetical order, so both the config file and the Apocasetter settings menu list them sorted. Newly discovered prefabs are appended and fall into place on the next start; your edited values are kept.
- No more per-entry comments: the `[Names]` section is written as one header line explaining the format followed by plain `prefab = Display Name` lines.
- An emptied value is regenerated from the game's item name / prefab name on the next start.

Requires [Apocasetter](https://github.com/DeonUrist/Apocasetter). Install: copy `Apocaspawner.dll` to `BepInEx\plugins\`.

mods.name: Apocatremors

mods.summary: Mutants burst out of the sand ahead of your car while you drive, more often the farther you go.

latest.title: Apocatremors 1.2.0
latest.notes:
Config cleanup + ambush clock change.

- The config now has only `[General]` (Enabled, ShowNotification, CooldownMinSeconds, CooldownMaxSeconds, SkipChance, DistanceMultiplier, DespawnDistance, MaxAlive), `[Apocapatrol]` (Enabled — the former AiCars, PlayerCooldownMultiplier, PlayerSkipChance) and `[Debug]` (TestKey, VerboseLog). Everything else is fixed in code at its former default; the per-creature sections are gone (their rules live in the code). Old keys and sections are removed from your cfg automatically.

Install: copy `Apocatremors.dll` into `BepInEx\plugins\` (BepInEx 5). DLL md5 `903451415cac4c6d8c691d13104a3d5a`.

mods.name: Gunplay
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Real bullets: travel time, tracers, range falloff, headshots, shotgun pellets, vehicle and wheel damage. Part of what was Apocaraider.

latest.title: Gunplay 1.0.0
latest.notes:
First standalone release. Projectile simulation for player and NPC shots: glowing tracers and crossbow bolts with travel time, per-weapon effective range and damage falloff, headshots, shotgun pellets, vehicle damage/penetration, wheel damage and detachment, corpse hit blood and stab sounds, human boss health. NPCAI and GunplayHUD hook in automatically when installed.

Part of the Apocaraider split: **Gunplay**, **GunplayHUD**, **NPCAI** and **WomenOfWasteland** replace the combined Apocaraider (now frozen). Each works on its own and with any combination of the others. **Remove Apocaraider** when installing these, otherwise its hooks run twice. Old Apocaraider settings are imported on first run.

**Install:** unzip into `BepInEx\plugins` (creates `BepInEx\plugins\Gunplay\`).

mods.name: Gunplay HUD
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: Hit markers, floating damage numbers and vehicle damage percentages, with an option to hide the crosshair. Part of what was Apocaraider.

latest.title: GunplayHUD 1.2.0
latest.notes:
GunplayHUD 1.2.0 adds configurable crosshairs and headshot audio while preserving existing hit feedback and optional Gunplay integration.

- Crosshair slider: 0 = none, 1 = vanilla, 2 = two horizontal lines, 3 = dot.
- Independent SelectionDot toggle for the unarmed selection dot.
- Headshot sound enabled by default, with a 75 ms minimum interval and at most two overlapping voices; busy clips are never restarted.
- Weapon dot is half its original displayed width and height. Headshot sound has 30% more sample gain, with peaks limited to the valid audio range.
- Existing TurnOffCrosshair settings migrate to the new controls; explicit new settings take precedence.
- Bundled crosshair textures and headshot.mp3 load from the plugin folder. Copy the complete GunplayHUD folder, including Textures and Sounds, when installing the release package.

Validation: release build passed with zero warnings/errors; 37 focused managed checks passed. Managed compatibility checks passed for all eight installation combinations containing GunplayHUD. In-game rendering and audio playback remain unverified.

The release ZIP will be attached manually.

latest.title: HealthStacks 1.0.0
latest.notes:
Tops up your partly used **Bandage (F1)** / **First Aid (F2)** from the ones you find.

- Press **Use (F)** on a bandage / first aid kit on the ground while your slot holds a partly used one: its charges move into your slot, up to **3**.

mods.name: NPCAI

latest.title: NPCAI 1.0.1
latest.notes:
NPCAI weapon ranges can now be changed only through the optional Gunplay mod.

- Removed NPCAI's six editable fallback range settings.
- Without Gunplay, NPCs use fixed ranges: pistol 60 m, SMG 70 m, rifle 120 m, sniper 250 m, shotgun 35 m, crossbow 90 m.

mods.name: Part Adjuster Tools
mods.author: DeonUrist
mods.summary: The Part Adjustment tool can also select the suspension: widen or narrow both axles and raise or lower the suspension (numpad 4/6/2/8, 0 resets), saved per car.

latest.title: Part Adjuster Tools 1.1.0
latest.notes:
Moves the native ADJUST CAR PARTS title and its instructions to the top left while adjusting an attached item or gauge with secondary Use (normally E). This keeps that block apart from the detailed item controls, which retain their existing position.

The native instructions keep their original styling and child layout, follow the game's Canvas scaling, and sit 20 canvas units from the top/left edges. Their original position and anchors are restored when adjustment ends, the tool is put away, gameplay is suspended or the UI runner is removed. Layout changes happen only on entry/exit.

All existing item/gauge controls, Left Alt fast steps, tool requirements, suspension wheel fixes and old-save recovery remain included.

Validation: release and native verifier builds with zero warnings/errors; 472 managed checks, 2,547 headless checks and 146 native Unity suspension checks passed. Hint checks cover panel separation and native position restoration. The layout uses measurements from the installed game's UI; interactive HUD rendering was not visually tested.

Extract the ZIP into BepInEx/plugins, replace the existing DLL and keep one active copy. Restart the game after updating.
